tg.conclusion: Reviewed Telegram v0.91.0 and v0.92.0 with the exact published command contract (Core 0.428.0, Base 0.57.0): the shared store moves to version 33; permissions are checked under each command's full key (messages.sync, bot.messages.sync) and a saved deny on either now stops the command; a saved permission key that names no command and the retired default_profile and analysis_* settings are refused with the config unset that removes them, while config show, set and unset still run; doctor --json lists every config problem in config.issues and reports a config file or folder other users can read under files with the chmod fix; config set keeps config.json at 0600; run records gain cli_command, agent and error; skill status, skill show --for and store tables list are new. RU/ES changed guides, changelog and technical reference reviewed. The native roadmap now drops bot button presses, chats start and chats app, so its portal correction was retired, as were the fixed MCP-guide lists (BUG-391), the removed search mail sentence and the analysis-setting option column; the generated reference has no empty Returns lists (BUG-392). The bot guide's --from start option is still corrected to --until-id. Chat notes, emoji reaction rankings, remaining max parity (privacy, calls, chat media, stickers, deleting or clearing a chat, group photo) and location remain planned.

max.conclusion: Reviewed MAX v0.74.0 to v0.76.0 (0.75.0 and 0.76.0), release commit d8c2911072aa259c89e1d375ae36345c3f4367a7, Core 0.428.0/Base 0.57.0. Roadmap unchanged from 0.47.0. The 0.42 security/search/usage/roadmap errata and the mcp upgrade-note erratum are retired because 0.47.0 ships those fixes. EN/RU/ES archive, configuration, mcp, search, security, sessions, troubleshooting, usage, commands and changelog reviewed. Source Zoom#245 corrects older released security/search/usage/roadmap claims; explicit portal runtime errata preserve the reviewed0.42 grammar and discovery contract3 rather than importing newer Core411 behavior. Custom/team-authorized Zoomapp required; no public shared app promised. Audio recording of attended calls, notes/speaker naming, broader preparation and additional platforms remain planned.

drive.conclusion: Reviewed released Drive 0.36.0 (Core 0.428.0/Base 0.57.0), covering 0.35.0. Since 0.35.0 drive reads setting names only as written: old setting names are refused as unknown settings like any other key, every command except config and doctor refuses a file with a problem and names its drive config unset fix, and doctor --json lists every problem under config.issues (kind, file, profile, key, what, fix). New config unset removes one setting from a profile, the defaults or the top of the file; config show/set/unset keep working on a file with problems. 0.36.0 saves config.json as 0600; doctor reports a config file or folder others can read under files.problems and prints the chmod; the refusal's (and N more problems) counts what doctor lists; skill status and skill show --for come from cli-base; housekeeping commands (doctor, config show, session list, runs, models, api list) show no profile in help. EN/RU/ES configuration (old-name paragraphs and the saved-default sentence removed; new Fix a problem in the file and Keep the file private sections), troubleshooting (doctor row, Name a profile), scenarios (every account command names personal; the portal profile correction retired because 0.35.0 ships it), commands and changelog reviewed. Roadmap: front matter in mirrored Markdown shipped (drive-cli#228, cli-core#1952) and is removed from Next by a portal correction until the native roadmap drops it; Google app review in progress, background watch service next, larger annotation copies and mirror deletion later. Earlier: Drive 0.34.0 (Core 0.422.0/Base 0.53.0). drive keeps a log of its runs like tg, max and wa: failed runs always, every run with --record or record: true in defaults, for keep_runs_for_days (30); runs list|show|path read them without a profile, and a run never holds a document id, name or text. Help and MCP examples speak of drive and name a profile. EN/RU/ES configuration (record, keep_runs_for_days, --record/--no-record), troubleshooting (failed-run symptom row), commands and changelog reviewed. Roadmap unchanged: Google app review in progress, background watch service and front matter next, larger annotation copies and mirror deletion later. Earlier: search --json hits carry cli-core's url and kind: "document", the same fields as memo search notes and search all; source_url is removed without an alias from hits and pictures, and a folder hit is told apart by not_read: "folder metadata only". An expired Google sign-in now tells an agent that signing in is the owner's step. EN/RU/ES search and usage now name url; the recipes and troubleshooting guide overrides (documents account, older-CLI refusal) are retired because 0.33.0 ships those pages. Roadmap unchanged from 0.32.0: Google app review in progress, background watch service and front matter next, larger annotation copies and mirror deletion later. Earlier review of 0.30.0 to 0.32.0: 0.32.0 keeps Drive documents in the store's own Google Drive account named by the drive profile; Core 0.420.0 moves them on first open (store versions 30 to 33), keeps every document:<id> reference, and older CLIs refuse the store until upgraded; two processes on one profile share a single Google sign-in refresh. 0.31.0 moves files list to the shared field query language (name:, modified_time with offsets, --timezone; raw Google queries stay under api), adds schema-derived list queries and joins a file's owner or editor with the mail contact of the same exact email. 0.30.0 removes mirrors sync/watch --public-url: Google Docs inserts only publicly downloadable images, so local images stay as Markdown text. EN/RU/ES mirrors (new section on when a Markdown file in Drive is enough; local images section rewritten), recipes (search only Drive documents from Memo with --source drive:<profile>), roadmap (tunnel image claim removed from the current summary), commands and changelog reviewed. Roadmap: background watch service and front matter stay next; larger annotation copies and mirror deletion stay later; Google app review stays in progress. The documents account and the older-CLI refusal reach the recipes and troubleshooting guides through docs-only guide overrides (drive PRs 220 and 222). No live Google request or global upgrade.
